name: Laravel 12 + MySQL Dashboard
note: Each task runs a real command. No token figures are recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost directly from the kit files. The suite runs against SQLite in-memory (DB_CONNECTION=sqlite, DB_DATABASE=:memory: in phpunit.xml) so no MySQL service is required; MySQL-specific settings are asserted against the shipped connection config, not a live server.

eval_tasks.title: Application installs and boots
eval_tasks.instruction: Composer dependencies must resolve and the Laravel application must bootstrap far enough to list its routes.

eval_tasks.title: Feature behaviour
eval_tasks.instruction: The kit's feature tests must pass.

eval_tasks.title: Declared security controls hold under test
eval_tasks.instruction: Run the suite that exercises the controls named in security/checks.json. Each test is mutation-verified: removing the control makes the test fail.
assertions: SQL-01 search input is bound, never interpolated
SQL-02/03 MySQL strict modes and utf8mb4 configured
AUTH-01 fillable whitelist, id not mass-assignable
CONC-01 transaction retry, CONC-02 compound index, CONC-03 cascade
OPS-01 /healthz, OPS-02 non-root Dockerfile, CI-01 clean .env.example

eval_tasks.title: Full suite green
eval_tasks.instruction: The complete suite must pass with no failures.
